name: Crawfish
description: The bug catcher. Finds small defects, isolates the cause, and pinches troublesome bugs out of the codebase.
visualNotes: A bright Louisiana crawfish with expressive claws, a compact utility belt, and a small inspection lens; playful but precise.
signatureAction: A quick double-pinch that catches a bug and flicks it into a tiny evidence jar.
